title: The Seeds — EN/ES/FR (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 100bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling intimate Spanish French language learning garden seeds Perth Zimbabwe
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The seeds are patience in the smallest possible form
A piece of information waiting for the warmth
You put them in the ground and you water them and wait
And the seeds remind you that the best things are not late

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
Las semillas son paciencia en la forma más pequeña
[The seeds are patience in the smallest form]
Un pedazo de información esperando el calor de la leña
[A piece of information waiting for the warmth]
Las pones en la tierra y las riegas y esperas
[You put them in the ground and water them and wait]
Las semillas te recuerdan que lo mejor no llega a destiempo — son enteras
[The seeds remind you that the best things are not late — they are complete]

[Chorus — English]
The seeds, the seeds
Small things with large intentions and particular needs
They know the season before the season knows itself
The seeds know more about the future than the shelf
The gardens still growing

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Les graines sont la patience dans la plus petite forme
[The seeds are patience in the smallest form]
Un morceau d'information attendant la chaleur conforme
[A piece of information waiting for the appropriate warmth]
Tu les mets dans la terre, tu les arroses et tu attends
[You put them in the ground, you water them and you wait]
Les graines savent la saison avant la saison — pour les gens
[The seeds know the season before the season — for people]

[Outro — All three languages]
The seeds… Las semillas… Les graines
Patience in the ground — Paciencia en la tierra — Patience dans la terre
The gardens still growing
